title: C schc: public fragmenter/reassembler API in lichen/schc.h (wrapper over schc_internal)
description: Smallest slice of b7z9.53.1 (decompose-first). The SCHC fragmenter (schc_fragmenter_init/next/input/timeout, schc_reassembler_*) exists and is vector-tested but is only reachable via schc_internal.h and called solely from tests/fuzz. Expose a public API in lichen/subsys/lichen/schc/include/lichen/schc.h: thin wrappers (e.g. lichen_schc_fragmenter_* mirroring the internal signatures, plus a lichen_schc_requires_fragmentation(len) helper mirroring Rust requires_fragmentation: len > MAX_SINGLE_FRAME_SCHC_PACKET — check the C constant's equivalent, likely LICHEN_FRAME_PAYLOAD_MAX-derived; keep names/cutoffs consistent with rust lichen-schc link.rs). No TX/RX wiring in this slice (that's the security-policy-dependent follow-up; parent b7z9.53.1). Tests: extend/imitate tests/schc_fragment_generation coverage through the public API. Rust reference: rust/lichen-schc/src/link.rs:248-293.
close_reason: Premise stale: the fragmenter/reassembler API is ALREADY public — lichen/subsys/schc/include/schc/schc.h:216-305 (schc_fragmenter_init/next/input/timeout, schc_reassembler_*, SCHC_OK, SCHC_FRAGMENT_RULE_A_TO_B) in the CONFIG_SCHC-gated Zephyr subsys lichen/subsys/schc; tests/fuzz/fuzz_schc.c consumes it via #include <schc/schc.h>. There is no schc_internal.h barrier (that header belongs to the separate lichen/subsys/lichen/schc compression subsys and contains only a micro-fragment codec). A wrapper layer would duplicate an existing public API — declined per simplicity bias. Remaining scope of parent b7z9.53.1 is the TX/RX wiring, tracked by its sibling bead (authenticated-fragmentation policy, blocked on l1qw.3.7.6.1).
